name: Toshiba 43V35KP (hayward, huashan_emT; Hisense/CVTE board, MediaTek mt5867), EU
warnings: NEVER disable this or any com.mediatek.* package.

Keep enabled:     com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.tv.service, com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, com.airoha.android.btd (Bluetooth remote pairing), com.cvte.autobacklight (keep), com.cvte.hotkey.receiver (if present — remote shortcut keys).

NEVER open (even to look): com.cvte.tv.fac.*, com.cvte.tv.hisensefac, com.cvte.tv.at, com.at.factory.*, mediatek.factorymenu.ui — on CVTE/Hisense boards, launching any factory app can flip a persistent factory-mode flag the shell cannot undo.  setupwraith: com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith is disabled in this list.
Disabling setupwraith gives Home back but costs Chromecast built-in (casting); keep it enabled if you cast.  com.at.factory.factorymanager: disabled and confirmed safe on this unit.
Leave it enabled if you are unsure, or if those packages come back after a reboot.  com.google.android.tvrecommendations: also confirmed stable across a full cold boot here.
If recommendations rows reappear after a reboot, re-enable it and leave it in; on other hayward firmware variants com.at.factory.factorymanager re-enables it at boot automatically.
